title: Microsoft Word
description: Start with the computer itself, then learn to write, format, decorate and save documents in Microsoft Word.

lessons.title: Introduction to the Computer
goals: What is computer (hardware: keyboard and screen, software)
Use enters to start a new line.

blocks.text: A computer is a device that can do many different things. Think of it like a really smart helper. Here are some things it can do:
Writing and Drawing: You can use it to write stories or draw pictures
Internet: You can use it to go online and find information, watch videos, or chat with friends.
Homework: It can help you do your homework and projects.
Games: You can play fun games on it.
It has two main parts: Hardware and software
Hardware: This includes all the physical parts of the computer that you can touch. Examples are:
Keyboard: "The keyboard is an input device that allows you to type letters, numbers, and other symbols into the computer."(Keyboard picture should be provided)
Screen/Monitor: "The screen (or monitor) displays everything you do on the computer, like a television."
Mouse/ Touchpad : "The mouse is an input device used to point, click, and interact with items on the screen."
More parts: Computer, containing other critical components like the CPU (central processing unit), memory (RAM), and storage (hard drive or SSD)."
Software: "Software consists of programs and applications that tell the computer what to do. Examples include:
Operating System: The main software that manages the computer’s hardware and other software. Examples include Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Applications: Programs that perform specific tasks, like web browsers, games, and word processors.
Drivers: Software that helps the operating system communicate with hardware devices.
Locate the Power Button : Find the power button on the computer tower or laptop.
Press the Power Button: Press it to turn on the computer.
Wait for Startup: Wait for the computer to boot up and the login screen to appear.
Enter Credentials: If prompted, enter your username and password.
Press Enter: Press the Enter key to log in.
Click the Start Button: Click on the Start button at the bottom left corner of the screen (Windows logo).
Find Microsoft Word: Look for Microsoft Word in the Start menu, or type "Word" in the search bar and click on the Microsoft Word icon.
Open Word: Double-click on the Word icon to open the program.
Start Typing: Click anywhere on the blank document to place the cursor and start typing using the keyboard.
Type Text: Begin typing your text into the document.
Press the Spacebar: To add a space between words, press the spacebar (the long horizontal key at the bottom of the keyboard).
7. Use Enter to Start a New Line
Press the Enter Key: To start a new line or paragraph, press the Enter key (usually located on the right side of the keyboard).
8. Save the Document on the Desktop
Click on File: Click on "File" at the top left corner of the Word window.
Select Save As: In the dropdown menu, select "Save As."
Choose Desktop: In the Save As window, select "Desktop" as the location to save the file.
Name the Document: Enter a name for your document in the "File name" field.
Click Save: Click the "Save" button. Your document is now saved on the desktop.
Click the Start Button: Click on the Start button at the bottom left corner of the screen.
Select Power: Click on the Power icon.
Choose Shut Down: Click on "Shut down" from the options.
Wait for Shutdown: Wait for the computer to completely turn off before turning off any power switches.
